study_assignment: Primary paper Mice Methods states animals randomly assigned to experimental groups; allocation restrictions and sequencing-subset selection details not established.
study_processing: The primary paper states samples from all groups processed in two batches, one library per brain. The per-animal batch assignment is unavailable in retrieved deposit.

timing.not_identified: Exact per-animal pulse and final-factor-off to harvest intervals, direct off-expression confirmation in these ten sequencing animals and matched induction-on baseline are absent in retrieved sample metadata.
timing.verified: Paper describes tet-off OSK induction around learning with Dox reintroduced immediately afterwards. Primary Nuclei Methods states harvest one day after remote water-maze recall; GEO says one day after last recall.
